In_Index.D.Description: S&P 500 Member at the Next Calendar Quarter-End, When the Forward Return Starts (Y/N)

Sector.D.Description: FMP Sector (current classification, applied to all periods)

Industry.D.Description: FMP Industry (current classification, applied to all periods)

Mkt_Cap.D.Description: Market Capitalization ($M) at the Forward-Return Start: Quarter-End Close x Period-End Diluted Shares

CFOPS_CAGR_3Yr.Description: Cash Flow from Operations per Share 3-Year CAGR

CFOPS_CAGR_5Yr.Description: Cash Flow from Operations per Share 5-Year CAGR

FCFPS_CAGR_3Yr.Description: Free Cash Flow per Share 3-Year CAGR

FCFPS_CAGR_5Yr.Description: Free Cash Flow per Share 5-Year CAGR

CapX_Intensity.Description: Capital Expenditures as % of Cash Flow from Operations; NaN if CFO <= 0

CapX_Intensity_3Yr.Description: 3-Year Capital Expenditures as % of 3-Year Cash Flow from Operations (cash-weighted average); NaN if 3-year CFO <= 0
CapX_Intensity_3Yr.Formula: ((CAPX.0 + CAPX.1 + CAPX.2) / (CFO.0 + CFO.1 + CFO.2) * 100).where((CFO.0 + CFO.1 + CFO.2) > 0)

CapX_Intensity_5Yr.Description: 5-Year Capital Expenditures as % of 5-Year Cash Flow from Operations (cash-weighted average); NaN if 5-year CFO <= 0
CapX_Intensity_5Yr.Formula: ((CAPX.0 + CAPX.1 + CAPX.2 + CAPX.3 + CAPX.4) / (CFO.0 + CFO.1 + CFO.2 + CFO.3 + CFO.4) * 100).where((CFO.0 + CFO.1 + CFO.2 + CFO.3 + CFO.4) > 0)

Asset_G_Rate.Description: Total Asset Growth (YoY Change in Total Assets; Fama-French Investment Measure)

Asset_G_Rate_3Yr.Description: Total Asset Growth, Annualized over 3 Years

Asset_G_Rate_5Yr.Description: Total Asset Growth, Annualized over 5 Years

E_P.Description: Earnings Yield (%): EPS / Price; negative for losses

S_P.Description: Sales Yield (%): Sales per Share / Price

B_P.Description: Book Yield (%): Book Value per Share / Price; negative for negative book equity

CFO_P.Description: Operating Cash Flow Yield (%): CFO per Share / Price

FCF_P.Description: Free Cash Flow Yield (%): FCF per Share / Price

EBITDA_EV.Description: EBITDA Yield on Enterprise Value (%); NaN if EV <= 0

CFO_EV.Description: Operating Cash Flow Yield on Enterprise Value (%); NaN if EV <= 0

EBITDA_EV_Rel_5Yr.Description: EBITDA Yield on EV (%) less its 5-Year Average (all periods in trailing 5 years, current included); positive = cheaper than usual; NaN if EV <= 0 in any of them

E_P_G5Yr.Description: Earnings Yield (%) x 5-Year SPS CAGR; NaN if SPS CAGR <= 0

S_P_G5Yr.Description: Sales Yield (%) x 5-Year SPS CAGR; NaN if SPS CAGR <= 0

B_P_G5Yr.Description: Book Yield (%) x 5-Year SPS CAGR; NaN if SPS CAGR <= 0

CFO_P_G5Yr.Description: Operating Cash Flow Yield (%) x 5-Year SPS CAGR; NaN if SPS CAGR <= 0

FCF_P_G5Yr.Description: Free Cash Flow Yield (%) x 5-Year SPS CAGR; NaN if SPS CAGR <= 0

EBITDA_EV_G5Yr.Description: EBITDA Yield on EV (%) x 5-Year SPS CAGR; NaN if EV <= 0 or SPS CAGR <= 0

CFO_EV_G5Yr.Description: Operating Cash Flow Yield on EV (%) x 5-Year SPS CAGR; NaN if EV <= 0 or SPS CAGR <= 0

PEG_3Yr.Description: P/E to 3-Year EPS CAGR (%); NaN if EPS <= 0 or CAGR <= 0

PEG_5Yr.Description: P/E to 5-Year EPS CAGR (%); NaN if EPS <= 0 or CAGR <= 0

P_E_Rel_5Yr.Description: P/E less its 5-Year Average (all periods in trailing 5 years, current included: 20 quarters on quarterly data); NaN if EPS <= 0 in any of them

ROA.Description: Return on Assets: Net Income / Average Total Assets (%)

ROIC.Description: Return on Invested Capital: NOPAT / Average Total Invested Capital (debt + equity + minority interest) (%); NaN if invested capital <= 0

CFO_MGN_3Yr.Description: Cash Flow from Operations Margin 3-Year Average

CFO_MGN_5Yr.Description: Cash Flow from Operations Margin 5-Year Average

EPS_Var_5Yr.Description: Earnings Per Share 5-Year Variability (Std Dev of YoY EPS Growth, %); NaN if any EPS <= 0 in window

Payout_Ratio_3Yr.Description: Common Stock Payout Ratio over 3 Years: 3-Year Dividends + Net Buybacks / 3-Year Earnings to Common (cash-weighted); NaN if 3-year earnings <= 0
Payout_Ratio_3Yr.Formula: ((COMM_PAYOUT.0 + COMM_PAYOUT.1 + COMM_PAYOUT.2) / (EARN_COMM.0 + EARN_COMM.1 + EARN_COMM.2) * 100).where((EARN_COMM.0 + EARN_COMM.1 + EARN_COMM.2) > 0)

Payout_Ratio_5Yr.Description: Common Stock Payout Ratio over 5 Years: 5-Year Dividends + Net Buybacks / 5-Year Earnings to Common (cash-weighted); NaN if 5-year earnings <= 0
Payout_Ratio_5Yr.Formula: ((COMM_PAYOUT.0 + COMM_PAYOUT.1 + COMM_PAYOUT.2 + COMM_PAYOUT.3 + COMM_PAYOUT.4) / (EARN_COMM.0 + EARN_COMM.1 + EARN_COMM.2 + EARN_COMM.3 + EARN_COMM.4) * 100).where((EARN_COMM.0 + EARN_COMM.1 + EARN_COMM.2 + EARN_COMM.3 + EARN_COMM.4) > 0)

FCF_Payout_Ratio_3Yr.Description: Free Cash Flow Payout Ratio over 3 Years: 3-Year Dividends + Net Buybacks / 3-Year Free Cash Flow (cash-weighted); NaN if 3-year FCF <= 0
FCF_Payout_Ratio_3Yr.Formula: ((COMM_PAYOUT.0 + COMM_PAYOUT.1 + COMM_PAYOUT.2) / (FCF.0 + FCF.1 + FCF.2) * 100).where((FCF.0 + FCF.1 + FCF.2) > 0)

FCF_Payout_Ratio_5Yr.Description: Free Cash Flow Payout Ratio over 5 Years: 5-Year Dividends + Net Buybacks / 5-Year Free Cash Flow (cash-weighted); NaN if 5-year FCF <= 0
FCF_Payout_Ratio_5Yr.Formula: ((COMM_PAYOUT.0 + COMM_PAYOUT.1 + COMM_PAYOUT.2 + COMM_PAYOUT.3 + COMM_PAYOUT.4) / (FCF.0 + FCF.1 + FCF.2 + FCF.3 + FCF.4) * 100).where((FCF.0 + FCF.1 + FCF.2 + FCF.3 + FCF.4) > 0)

1M_Return.Description: 1-Month Price Return to the Forward-Return Start (Calendar Quarter-End)

3M_Return.Description: 3-Month Price Return to the Forward-Return Start (Calendar Quarter-End)

Fwd_Return_1Yr.Y.Description: Forward 1-Year Total Return, Annualized, from the Calendar Quarter-End After the Period (Backtest Label; Uses Future Prices)

Fwd_Return_3Yr.Y.Description: Forward 3-Year Total Return, Annualized, from the Calendar Quarter-End After the Period (Backtest Label; Uses Future Prices)

Fwd_Return_5Yr.Y.Description: Forward 5-Year Total Return, Annualized, from the Calendar Quarter-End After the Period (Backtest Label; Uses Future Prices)

Fwd_Excess_Return_1Yr.Y.Description: Forward 1-Year Annualized Total Return less S&P 500 (SPY) Annualized Total Return (Backtest Label)

Fwd_Excess_Return_3Yr.Y.Description: Forward 3-Year Annualized Total Return less S&P 500 (SPY) Annualized Total Return (Backtest Label)

Fwd_Excess_Return_5Yr.Y.Description: Forward 5-Year Annualized Total Return less S&P 500 (SPY) Annualized Total Return (Backtest Label)

SHARES_END.Description: Period-End Shares (Diluted Weighted Avg of Final Quarter)

CFOPS.Description: Cash Flow from Operations per Share

PE.Description: Price to Earnings Ratio; NaN if EPS <= 0

EPS_CAGR_3Y.Description: Earnings Per Share 3-Year CAGR (%); NaN if either endpoint EPS <= 0

EPS_CAGR_5Y.Description: Earnings Per Share 5-Year CAGR (%); NaN if either endpoint EPS <= 0

EBITDA.Description: Earnings Before Interest, Taxes, Depreciation and Amortization

PAY_RATIO.Description: Total Payout Ratio (Dividends + Net Buybacks) to Common

NET_DEBT.Description: Total Debt less Cash & Cash Equivalents

INV_RATE.Description: Rate of Fixed Investment (Capex / Average Total Assets)

TAX_RATE.Description: Effective Tax Rate (TTM), bounded to 0-50%; 21% US statutory rate when pre-tax income <= 0

NOPAT.Description: Net Operating Profit After Tax: Operating Income x (1 - Effective Tax Rate)

TOT_INV_CAP.Description: Total Invested Capital: Total Debt + Shareholder Equity + Minority Interest (cash not netted)

AVG_TOT_INV_CAP.Description: Average Total Invested Capital (current and year-ago)

Price.Description: Close Price, Last Trading Day On or Before the Next Calendar Quarter-End (when the forward return starts)

Price_1M_Ago.Description: Close 1 Month Before the Forward-Return Start (Month-End Before the Calendar Quarter-End)

Price_3M_Ago.Description: Close 3 Months Before the Forward-Return Start (Previous Calendar Quarter-End)

Price_6M_Ago.Description: Close 6 Months Before the Forward-Return Start (Calendar Quarter-End)

Price_12M_Ago.Description: Close 12 Months Before the Forward-Return Start (Calendar Quarter-End)

Price_24M_Ago.Description: Close 24 Months Before the Forward-Return Start (Calendar Quarter-End)

SP_Price.Description: S&P 500 Close at the Next Calendar Quarter-End (Forward-Return Start)

SP_6M_Ago.Description: S&P 500 Close 6 Months Before the Forward-Return Start

SP_12M_Ago.Description: S&P 500 Close 12 Months Before the Forward-Return Start

SP_24M_Ago.Description: S&P 500 Close 24 Months Before the Forward-Return Start

SECTOR.Description: FMP Sector (current; FMP keeps no classification history)

INDUSTRY.Description: FMP Industry (current; FMP keeps no classification history)

IN_INDEX.Description: S&P 500 Member at the Next Calendar Quarter-End, When the Forward Return Starts (Y/N), Point-in-Time

FILED_BY_QE1.Description: 1 if the period's report was filed on or before the next calendar quarter-end (when the forward return starts), else 0

PRICE_ADJ_QE1.Description: Dividend-Adjusted Close, Last Trading Day On or Before the Next Calendar Quarter-End (Forward Return Start)

PRICE_ADJ_QE5.Description: Dividend-Adjusted Close, Last Trading Day On or Before the Calendar Quarter-End 1 Year After the Start

PRICE_ADJ_QE13.Description: Dividend-Adjusted Close, Last Trading Day On or Before the Calendar Quarter-End 3 Years After the Start

PRICE_ADJ_QE21.Description: Dividend-Adjusted Close, Last Trading Day On or Before the Calendar Quarter-End 5 Years After the Start

SPY_ADJ_QE1.Description: SPY (S&P 500 Total Return Proxy) Dividend-Adjusted Close, Last Trading Day On or Before the Next Calendar Quarter-End (Forward Return Start)

SPY_ADJ_QE5.Description: SPY (S&P 500 Total Return Proxy) Dividend-Adjusted Close, Last Trading Day On or Before the Calendar Quarter-End 1 Year After the Start

SPY_ADJ_QE13.Description: SPY (S&P 500 Total Return Proxy) Dividend-Adjusted Close, Last Trading Day On or Before the Calendar Quarter-End 3 Years After the Start

SPY_ADJ_QE21.Description: SPY (S&P 500 Total Return Proxy) Dividend-Adjusted Close, Last Trading Day On or Before the Calendar Quarter-End 5 Years After the Start

FWD_RET_1Y.Description: Forward 1-Year Total Return, Annualized (%), Quarter-End to Quarter-End Starting the Quarter After the Period; NaN if Not Yet Filed at the Start

FWD_RET_3Y.Description: Forward 3-Year Total Return, Annualized (%), Quarter-End to Quarter-End Starting the Quarter After the Period; NaN if Not Yet Filed at the Start

FWD_RET_5Y.Description: Forward 5-Year Total Return, Annualized (%), Quarter-End to Quarter-End Starting the Quarter After the Period; NaN if Not Yet Filed at the Start

SPY_FWD_RET_1Y.Description: SPY Forward 1-Year Total Return, Annualized (%), Same Quarter-End Window as FWD_RET_1Y

SPY_FWD_RET_3Y.Description: SPY Forward 3-Year Total Return, Annualized (%), Same Quarter-End Window as FWD_RET_3Y

SPY_FWD_RET_5Y.Description: SPY Forward 5-Year Total Return, Annualized (%), Same Quarter-End Window as FWD_RET_5Y
